turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail: Chubbies will help arrange a replacement or store credit. For regular returns (like if you just changed your mind), you can get a refund within 30 days, or store credit/exchange within 90 days for manufacturing defects.If the damage is from general wear and tear (like snagging, stains, or shrinkage from washing), it’s not eligible for replacement or refund.To get started, I’ll need your order number and a quick description of the damaged item. Once I have that, I’ll help you with the next steps!
